title: 最上（Mogami） — original low-poly interpretation
author: navyfield project contributors
historicalApproximation: Original procedural low-poly interpretation from general historical silhouette facts; not an exact historical reconstruction, game asset extraction, or reproduction of any source artwork. Slender Japanese heavy-cruiser hull, tiered bridge, unequal raked funnels and recessed side torpedo bays interpret Mogami without specifying an exact wartime conversion.
targetArmament: Three twin main mounts follow TARGET instead of the historical five twin heavy-cruiser positions. Two manual quad torpedo mounts are displayed in opposite side bays; numeric secondary origins remain unchanged.
references: TARGET ship name and general public historical facts about nationality, class, hull, bridge, funnel and armament silhouettes; no source artwork reconstructed.
numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.
